stage: Phase 1B (sales metric + ranking only; no quantity, no fill call)

metric.name: net_qty_6m
metric.definition: shipped quantity minus returns/cancellations, per SKU, over six complete months; zero-filled for months without rows
metric.date_field_note: sale_date would give 1,326 mother-set SKUs vs 1,328 for despatch_date (2-SKU difference); despatch_date is frozen and the difference is recorded, not silently switched
metric.zero_fill: every SKU carries all six months with rows=0/qty=0 marked zero_filled

returns_and_cancellations.rule: qty is summed as signed; this snapshot has 0 negative lines, so net equals shipped. gs_orders has no status field, so cancellations cannot be removed beyond what the source already excludes

test_order_exclusion.note: Excluding test lines does not drop a SKU: affected SKUs keep their non-test sales and stay in the table

internal_transfer_exclusion.note: 0 rows matched in the window; the search is recorded so it is recomputable

kit_and_unit_rules.unit_basis: all 1,237 eligible items have BOM uom in 件/个/套 (Phase 1A check); 29 items without a BOM row were excluded from the eligible set, so no unit mixing in this ranking
kit_and_unit_rules.kit_rule: a TJ# bundle row would be counted once and its component rows excluded; the window contains 0 TJ# sales rows, so no bundle/component double count exists here

metric.traceability: each row carries 6 monthly cells and first/last line_id over its gs_orders predicate

stratification.rationale: single-dimension dominance: '三角靠枕' is 63.2% of eligible net quantity (>= 50%), so ranks are computed inside strata and Top 50 seats are allocated by stratum share
